title: Total influence under quarter switching
statement: Assume that every Boolean function with a disjunctive or conjunctive normal form of width at most a positive integer $w$ has switching failure probability at rate $1/(20w)$ at most $4^{-k}$ for every natural number $k$. Let $T$ be a circuit tail with $m$ inputs, let $g$ be an AND or OR gate, and suppose each input function has a normal form appropriate to $g$ of width at most $w$. If $N$ is the number of internal gates of $T$ and $N+1\le s$, then the total influence of the real-valued function computed by $T$ is at most $2w\bigl(20(\lceil\log_2(s+1)\rceil+2)\bigr)^{L-1}$, where $L$ is the number of layers of $T$.
